AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 19, 2019
REGULAR MEETING
  6:00 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Margarita L. Rios, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Leonard Shryock, Councilmember
  Luigi Vernola, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
   Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Assessor Parcel Number 8082-013-905; Negotiating on behalf of the City: Jesus Gomez,
  City Manager; Negotiating Party: Department of the Air Force; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of
  Payment.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Pastor Hector Gomez
  New Branch Ministries

FLAG SALUTE
  Liliana Hiddleson, 5th grade
  Dolland Elementary School

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to present Awards to the Winners of the 2018 Holiday Home and Business Décor Contest.

  II.  City Council to recognize the 2018 Angel Tree Program Sponsors.

  III.  City Council to recognize the Norwalk Transportation Department’s 2018 Stuff-A-Bus Donors.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  Mayor’s Prayer Breakfast

  2.  Meet and Greet with Sheriff Alex Villanueva

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of
  February 5, 2019. 825-04

  Report
   2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period January 13, 2019 –
  January 26, 2019, in the total amount of $903,997.45. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  January 30, 2019 – February 12, 2019, in the total amount of $2,067,130.11. 640

  Report

  4.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – FEBRUARY 13 , 2019 - No action is required unless the City
  Council elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the
  Commission’s action was final. 320

  Report

  5.  APPROVAL OF SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE FOR THE INSTALLATION
  OF CHAIN LINK FENCE ON ACQUIRED TANK FARM PROPERTY ADJACENT TO HOLIFIELD PARK,
  ENGINEERS REPORT NO. 19-05 - Staff recommends City Council approve specifications for the
  installation of chain link fence at the tank farm property, authorize advertisement for bids, and set a bid
  opening date of March 14, 2019. 935-01

  Report

  6.  PROJECT NO. 7229 - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO
  ADVERTISE FOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL AND CURB RAMP IMPROVEMENTS - STUDEBAKER ROAD
  BETWEEN ALONDRA BOULEVARD AND ROSECRANS AVENUE, FEDERAL NO. HSIPL-5347(039),
  ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 19-07 – Staff recommends City Council approve plans and specifications
  for construction of traffic signal improvements for Project No. 7229, Studebaker Road between Alondra
  Boulevard and Rosecrans Avenue, authorize advertisement for bids, and set a bid opening date of
  March 19, 2019. 1005-04-7229

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  7.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

REPORTS

  8.  APPROVAL OF SPECIFICATIONS AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE FOR THE PURCHASE
  AND INSTALLATION OF LIGHT EMITTING DIODE (LED) FIXTURES FOR CITY-OWNED STREET
  LIGHT POLES, PROJECT NO. 3305-2069, ENGINEERS REPORT NO. 19-06 - Staff recommends City
  Council approve specifications for the purchase and installation of LED street light fixtures and related
  equipment, Project No. 3305-2069, authorize advertisement for bids, and set a bid opening date of
  March 21, 2019. 1030/1060-01-01

  Report

  9.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO PROVIDE PLAN CHECK AND BUILDING INSPECTION SERVICES –
  Staff recommends City Council award a contract to Scott Fazekas & Associates, Inc. for plan check
  and related services for a term of July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2024 in the amount not-to-exceed
  $222,000 annually; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any amendments
  provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.
  305-02

  Report
   10. RESOLUTION NO. 19-05 - FISCAL YEAR 2018/19 MID–YEAR BUDGET REVIEW – Staff
  recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-05, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING MIDYEAR AMENDMENTS TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2018/19
  BUDGET. 610

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated February 15, 2019.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
